meta_title: SR Driver Plumbing & Heating | Plumber Leicester
meta_description: SR Driver Plumbing & Heating offers expert plumbing and heating services across Leicester. Reliable, local, and fairly priced. Call today for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Gas Safe Registered — Leicester's Trusted Heating Specialist
hero_subhead: Boiler breakdowns, leaks, or a new heating system — we get it sorted fast, with no hidden costs.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Leicester
services_subhead: From emergency callouts to full boiler installations, we cover every plumbing and heating need for homeowners across Leicester and the surrounding villages.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: We supply and fit A-rated combi and system boilers from leading brands, ensuring your home stays warm and efficient. All installations are carried out by our Gas Safe registered engineer.

services.title: Boiler Servicing & Repairs
services.desc: Regular servicing keeps your boiler running safely and extends its lifespan. We diagnose and repair faults on all makes and models, getting your heating back up and running with minimal disruption.

services.title: Central Heating Systems
services.desc: Whether you need a full central heating installation or a power flush to improve efficiency, we design and fit systems tailored to your home's requirements.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, blocked drains, or a sudden leak — we respond quickly across Leicester to limit damage and restore normality to your home as fast as possible.

services.title: Bathroom Installations
services.desc: From a simple tap replacement to a complete bathroom refit, we handle all plumbing aspects with a clean, professional finish that stands the test of time.

services.title: Landlord Gas Safety Certificates
services.desc: We carry out annual CP12 gas safety inspections and issue certificates promptly, keeping your rental property compliant and your tenants safe.

about_pullquote: Every job gets the same care, whether it's a washer or a full boiler install.
about_para_1: SR Driver Plumbing & Heating has been serving homeowners across Leicester and the surrounding villages from our base in Great Glen for over 15 years. Founded by a fully qualified, Gas Safe registered engineer, the business was built on a straightforward promise: turn up on time, do the job properly, and charge a fair price.
about_para_2: We work across all of Leicestershire, from the city centre to rural communities like Great Glen, Oadby, and Wigston. Our customers return to us time and again because we communicate clearly, leave homes clean and tidy, and never cut corners — values that have earned us an outstanding local reputation entirely through word of mouth.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About SR Driver

reviews.text: Absolutely brilliant service. Our boiler packed in on a cold Thursday evening and SR Driver had it sorted by Friday morning. No fuss, really fair price, and the engineer was polite and tidy throughout. Would highly recommend to anyone in Leicester.
reviews.author: Karen B.

reviews.text: Used SR Driver for a full bathroom replumb and couldn't be happier. Turned up exactly when they said they would, completed the work to a really high standard, and left everything spotless. Will definitely be using them again for our boiler service.
reviews.author: James T.

reviews.text: Had a nasty leak under the kitchen sink that two other plumbers couldn't trace. SR Driver found it within 20 minutes and fixed it properly the same day. Honest, knowledgeable, and genuinely good value. This is my go-to plumber from now on.
reviews.author: Priya M.
